title: Johns Hopkins University Taiwanese Student Association
content_html:
The Johns Hopkins University Taiwanese Student Association (JHUTSA) is a student organization at Johns Hopkins University in Baltimore, Maryland. Its founding year is not documented in available first-party sources. JHUTSA primarily serves students from Taiwan and the broader Taiwanese diaspora, while also welcoming students of non-Taiwanese background who wish to engage with Taiwanese culture.

According to its Hopkins Groups directory listing, JHUTSA exists to support the educational, cultural, and social needs of its members and the university community, and aims to increase cross-cultural awareness by helping students of non-Taiwanese descent better understand the Taiwanese and Taiwanese-American communities. The organization provides a shared platform for students to communicate, celebrate Taiwanese culture, and gather in a welcoming social community.

JHUTSA maintains a Facebook presence, where its Chinese name—約翰霍普金斯大學台灣學生會—appears. A note on that page indicates the Facebook page is no longer actively used and directs new members to a separate Facebook group. No dedicated website or Instagram account was identified in available first-party sources.
